answer.text: The manual says the front and rear brake pads must be checked for wear at the intervals given in the periodic maintenance chart.
It says the pads need to be replaced if a brake pad is warm to the indicator.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not give a pad thickness, distance or time at which to replace the pads, and its wording on the wear indicator is unclear. Please confirm with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.
